title.fa: آنان که مشارکت نکردند: اندیشیدن، «زیستن با خود» و ناپایداری ارزش‌ها نزد آرنت
title.en: Those who did not participate: thinking, 'living with oneself' and the fragility of values in Arendt
title.nl: Zij die niet meededen: denken, 'met jezelf leven' en de broosheid van waarden bij Arendt

summary.fa: آرنت می‌پرسد کسانی که در رژیم نازی همکاری نکردند چه فرقی داشتند. پاسخش: نه نظام ارزشی بهتر، بلکه توانایی داوریِ مستقل و رابطهٔ صادقانه با خود. در بحران، پایبندانِ صرف به ارزش‌ها و هنجارها قابل اعتماد نیستند چون ارزش‌ها یک‌شبه عوض می‌شوند؛ شکاک‌ها قابل‌اعتمادترند.
summary.en: Arendt asks what distinguished the few who did not collaborate under Nazi rule. Her answer: not a better set of values but the capacity for independent judgment and an honest relation to oneself. In crisis, mere adherents of values and norms are unreliable because values change overnight; sceptics are more reliable.
summary.nl: Arendt vraagt wat de weinigen die niet meewerkten onderscheidde. Haar antwoord: niet betere waarden, maar zelfstandig oordelen en een eerlijke verhouding tot jezelf.

text.fa: به نظر او آنچه نخست آزارش می‌داد رفتار دشمنان نبود؛ رفتار دوستانی بود که یک‌شبه با «هماهنگ‌شدن» با رژیم عقیده عوض کردند و رابطه‌شان را با دوستان قدیمی بریدند. او این را بیش از مسئولیت شخصی، از کارافتادنِ گستردهٔ قوهٔ داوری می‌داند.
text.en: What troubled her first, she says, was not the enemies' behaviour but that of friends who changed opinion overnight by 'coordinating' with the regime and dropped old friends. She reads this less as personal responsibility than as a broad breakdown of the power of judgment.
text.nl: What troubled her first, she says, was not the enemies' behaviour but that of friends who changed opinion overnight by 'coordinating' with the regime and dropped old friends. She reads this less as personal responsibility than as a broad breakdown of the power of judgment.

text.fa: کسانی که کنار ماندند به نظر او نه نظام ارزشیِ بهتر داشتند و نه معیارهای قدیمی در وجدانشان ریشه‌دارتر بود؛ برعکس، اعضای محترم جامعه که از دگرگونی‌های آغازین متأثر نشده بودند نخستین کسانی بودند که تن دادند، چون صرفاً یک مجموعه ارزش را با مجموعه‌ای دیگر عوض کردند.
text.en: Those who stayed out, she says, had neither a better value system nor older standards rooted more firmly in conscience; on the contrary, respectable members of society, unaffected by the early upheavals, were among the first to comply, merely swapping one set of values for another.
text.nl: Those who stayed out, she says, had neither a better value system nor older standards rooted more firmly in conscience; on the contrary, respectable members of society, unaffected by the early upheavals, were among the first to comply, merely swapping one set of values for another.

text.fa: معیار آنان به گمان آرنت این بود که پس از انجام کاری تا چه حد می‌توانند با خود در صلح زندگی کنند. نخواستند جنایت کنند نه چون هنوز به «قتل مکن» باور داشتند، بلکه چون نمی‌خواستند با یک قاتل، یعنی خودشان، زندگی کنند.
text.en: Their criterion, as she sees it, was how far they could live at peace with themselves after certain acts. They refused to commit crime not so much from firm belief in 'thou shalt not kill' as from unwillingness to live with a murderer, namely themselves.
text.nl: Their criterion, as she sees it, was how far they could live at peace with themselves after certain acts. They refused to commit crime not so much from firm belief in 'thou shalt not kill' as from unwillingness to live with a murderer, namely themselves.

text.fa: پیش‌شرط این داوری هوش بالا یا کمال اخلاقی نیست، بلکه آمادگی برای یکرنگی با خود است: همان گفتگوی خاموشِ خود با خویشتن که از سقراط و افلاطون «اندیشیدن» نامیده شده است. او تأکید می‌کند این اندیشیدن تخصصی نیست و مرز میان کسانی که می‌اندیشند و کسانی که نمی‌اندیشند به فاصلهٔ طبقاتی یا آموزشی ربط ندارد.
text.en: The precondition of such judgment is not high intelligence or moral accomplishment but readiness to be at one with oneself: the silent dialogue of the self with itself that, since Socrates and Plato, has been called thinking. She stresses it is not specialist, and the line between those who think and those who do not has nothing to do with social or educational differences.
text.nl: The precondition of such judgment is not high intelligence or moral accomplishment but readiness to be at one with oneself: the silent dialogue of the self with itself that, since Socrates and Plato, has been called thinking. She stresses it is not specialist, and the line between those who think and those who do not has nothing to do with social or educational differences.

text.fa: نتیجهٔ عملی‌اش این است که در چنین شرایطی پاسداران ارزش‌ها و هنجارها قابل اعتماد نیستند، چون ارزش‌ها یکشبه تغییر می‌کنند و فقط عادتِ پایبندی می‌ماند. شکاکان قابل‌اعتمادترند، نه از آن رو که شکاکیت خوب است بلکه چون مسائل را می‌سنجند. بهترین‌ها کسانی‌اند که فقط یک چیز را مسلم می‌دانند: تا زنده‌ایم باید با خود زندگی کنیم.
text.en: Her practical conclusion is that in such conditions guardians of values and norms are unreliable, because values can change overnight leaving only the habit of adherence. Sceptics are more reliable, not because scepticism is good but because they examine matters. The best are those sure of one thing only: that as long as we live we must live with ourselves.
text.nl: Her practical conclusion is that in such conditions guardians of values and norms are unreliable, because values can change overnight leaving only the habit of adherence. Sceptics are more reliable, not because scepticism is good but because they examine matters. The best are those sure of one thing only: that as long as we live we must live with ourselves.

text.fa: او می‌پذیرد که دربارهٔ آن اندک کناره‌گیران که «بی‌مسئولیت» خوانده می‌شوند باید گفت در شرایطی استثنایی مسئولیت در قبال جهان که اساساً سیاسی است بدون حداقلی از قدرت ممکن نیست؛ ناتوانیِ کامل عذر موجه است و حتی اعتراف به آن نیازمند فضیلت و حسن نیت است. او با اشاره به وکیل آیشمن که کشتارگاه‌ها را «مسئله‌ای پزشکی» نامید، می‌گوید اخلاق در فروپاشی‌اش به معنای ابتدایی خود، یعنی مجموعه‌ای از آداب، برملا شد که می‌شود مثل آداب غذاخوردن عوض کرد.
text.en: She grants that for the few withdrawers accused of irresponsibility one must say that in extreme situations responsibility for the world, which is mainly political, cannot be assumed without a minimum of power; total inability is a valid excuse, and even admitting it takes virtue and good faith. Citing Eichmann's lawyer calling the death camps a 'medical matter', she says morality at its collapse showed itself in its original sense of customs that can be swapped like table manners.
text.nl: She grants that for the few withdrawers accused of irresponsibility one must say that in extreme situations responsibility for the world, which is mainly political, cannot be assumed without a minimum of power; total inability is a valid excuse, and even admitting it takes virtue and good faith. Citing Eichmann's lawyer calling the death camps a 'medical matter', she says morality at its collapse showed itself in its original sense of customs that can be swapped like table manners.

text.fa: این گفته که اندیشیدنِ درونی مانع همکاری با شر می‌شود، یک تز فلسفی است و آزمون تجربیِ مستقیم نشده است. پژوهش‌های روان‌شناسی اجتماعی دربارهٔ اطاعت (مثل آزمایش‌های میلگرم) بر فشار موقعیت تأکید می‌کنند و در نگاه اول با تکیهٔ آرنت بر داوری فردی کشاکش دارند؛ دو رویکرد را بیشتر مکمل می‌دانند تا جایگزین.
text.en: The claim that inner thinking blocks collaboration with evil is a philosophical thesis, not directly tested empirically. Social-psychology research on obedience (e.g. Milgram's experiments) stresses situational pressure and sits in tension with Arendt's reliance on individual judgment; the two approaches are better seen as complementary than as replacements.
text.nl: The claim that inner thinking blocks collaboration with evil is a philosophical thesis, not directly tested empirically. Social-psychology research on obedience (e.g. Milgram's experiments) stresses situational pressure and sits in tension with Arendt's reliance on individual judgment; the two approaches are better seen as complementary than as replacements.

note.en: From 'why did you obey?' to 'why did you support?'
